name: openbb_economy_cpi
description:
Consumer price inflation for a country (year-on-year percent, monthly) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.cpi).
Returns: {country, provider, data_points, truncated, cpi_data: [records with date, country, value]} or {country, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (e.g. united_states, japan; default united_states); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fred, imf, oecd; default oecd).
US-only alternatives: av_cpi, fred_cpi, fred_core_cpi. Keys: imf, oecd need none; fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY.
Example: {"country": "japan"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
